about_the_game:
🚗 Early Access: Lane Hunters – Become the New Legend of Street Racing!

🛣️ Master the art of lane-cutting in intense 1v1 street races! Lane Hunters challenges those seeking the ultimate combination of adrenaline, strategy, and skilled driving! Choose your customized vehicle, skillfully cut through heavy traffic, go head-to-head against rivals, earn experience points with daring near misses, and customize your ride exactly the way you want.
🚗 Dominate the traffic, showcase your skills, and become king of the streets!

🚦 Game Modes

🏁 1v1 Duel Mode: Challenge Your Rivals!

🚗 Choose your car, find a worthy opponent, and battle through intense traffic!
⛽ Once the countdown begins at the gas station, it's your moment to shine!
⚠️ Simple rule: Dodge cars, outmaneuver your opponent, open a 100-meter gap, and maintain it for 10 seconds to claim victory!
✨ Matches are best-of-3 rounds; first to win 2 rounds wins the duel.
⚡ Take risks, master near misses, and psychologically dominate your opponent!
🏅 Rank up, race tougher opponents, and rise to the top!

🚗 Race Solo or Team Up with Friends!

🤝 Co-op Mode: Create a private room, invite friends, and hit the road together!
Join ongoing races from the nearest gas station—never miss out on the action!
🌟 Solo Mode: Pick your car, roam freely, and master your skills solo!
Practice freely on your favorite map.
🎯 Race alone or with friends—your road, your choice!

🎮 Character Progression & Vehicle Mods

🏅 Unlimited Character Progression: Earn endless experience points (EXP) and skill points to continuously upgrade your vehicles.
Selling your vehicle resets skill points, requiring you to level up again.

🛠️ Rewards & Economy System

🏆 Win Races, Earn Exclusive Parts! Secure special spoilers, rims, and rare vehicles through victories.
Use your earnings to purchase and personalize vehicles from the in-game Market.
Sell earned parts on the Steam Market to shape the economy!


🔧🚗 Vehicle Upgrades & Customization

⚙️ Performance Tuning:

Distribute points to Torque, Turbo PSI, Max RPM, Brakes, Grip, NOS, and Transmission. Each attribute has its own maximum upgrade limit.

🎨 Personalize Your Style!

Modify your vehicle’s color, spoiler, rims, and suspension.
Trade your preferred parts on the Steam Market.

🔄 Vehicle Modes: Quick Style Switch!

Master two distinct driving modes: Standard and Drift.
Switch instantly between modes mid-race for sharp turns and controlled drifting!

🚦 Traffic & Environment

🚙 Realistic Traffic System:

Expertly optimized traffic flow, featuring trucks, vans, and passenger cars designed for smooth, thrilling lane-cutting.

🌲 Stunning Race Environments:

Start at a gas station, speed through deep forests, and finish under city lights on captivating highways.
Enjoy multiple maps in dynamic day and night modes!

🚀 Join Early Access and Help Shape Development!

Participate in an innovative 1v1 racing experience full of skill, strategy, and intense near misses. Your feedback during Early Access directly influences the game's future!
🏅 Take the wheel, improve your skills, and rise through the ranks to become the new street racing legend!

See you on the highway! 🏎️💨

🗺️ Lane Hunters Roadmap

🚗 Demo Version (Launching in April!) ✅ Co-op Mode: Race and free roam with your friends.
✅ 3 Different Vehicles: Showcase your skills with starter vehicles.
✅ Basic Customization: Vehicle color options.
✅ Free Roam: Enjoy open-road driving.

🚀 Early Access 🔥 1v1 Duel Mode: Intense head-to-head races in traffic.
🔥 Level & Rank System: Rank up, earn skill points, and upgrade your vehicle.
🔥 Advanced Customization: Colors, spoilers, and rims.
🔥 Vehicle Driving Modes: Quickly switch between Standard and Drift modes.

🌟 Full Release Goals 🚘 Comprehensive Customization: Complete tuning, including engine performance and cosmetics.
💰 Steam Market Integration: Sell parts you earn, manage the in-game economy.
🚦 Complete Game Modes: Fully-featured 1v1 duels and expanded co-op play.
🛣️ Additional Content: New vehicles, maps, events, and more!

🎯 Shape the game’s future together with us!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 8700k / AMD 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060, RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: SSD required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 10500 / AMD 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070, Radeon RX 5600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: SSD required

short_description: Lane Hunters is an action-packed street racing game where you skillfully weave through heavy traffic in intense 1v1 duels. Outsmart rivals with strategy and skill, customize your car, and become a street legend solo or with friends in co-op mode!
